systems.country_label: Nidaamka Aqoonsiga Qaran ee Casriga ah (DNIS)
systems.platform: to be open-source technology managed by the Authority and not dependent on one vendor (Art. 6)
systems.owner: National Identification and Registration Authority (Hay'adda Aqoonsiga iyo Diiwaan-gelinta Qaranka), under the Minister of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation
systems.tiers: fixed registration centres, mobile registration centres and online registration (Art. 11); embassies and consulates abroad; mobile centres for rural and remote areas in mass registration (Art. 12)
one or more electronic registers holding ID numbers, demographic and biometric data, kept inside Somalia (Art. 7)

systems.system: ID card verification service for relying parties

note: A regulation on national identity enrolment, not civil registration: it defines civil registration (dad-dhigid) as the permanent, compulsory recording of births, marriages, divorces, deaths and adoptions and refers to a separate authority responsible for it (Art. 20(10)), accepts civil registration documents as proof of identity (Art. 17) and suspends an ID number 60 days after a death is registered (Art. 24), but describes no civil registration system, office or method of record.
